div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: Start or resume the existing campaign

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Acquire nonblocking supervisor lock
One owner per user home

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Validate saved identity, configuration and run manifest
Keep original start and cutoff
Default duration: 12 hours; configurable

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Check saved PID identity before recovery
Reap owned orphan group; close interrupted repair
Replay audit outbox; retain original incident

div.style: color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Reject unsafe startup
Do not claim another owner's process
Preserve existing campaign evidence

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Persisted blocked phase
or repair-account quota block?

div.style: color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Exit 2 with campaign state preserved
Existing owner requires explicit reconciliation
Restart alone does not clear the blocker

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Original cutoff reached
or stop requested?

div.style: color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Stop and reap owned child processes
Preserve world, checkpoint and original cutoff

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Pending action and source revision
missing or changed?

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Capture reconciliation incident
Do not launch gameplay against changed source

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Record source revision and segment
Durably persist child-launch audit transition
Audit failure stops further launches

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Resume FLE hierarchical controller
Same checkpoint and session; remaining time only
Hybrid policy; Jev 1.13.0; configured features

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Monitor checkpoint, owned process and fresh health
Default polling interval: 5 seconds

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Fresh matching health shows provider,
storage or maintenance hold,
or an owned pending/background job?

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Refresh watchdog baseline
Keep observing without invoking source repair
A heartbeat alone is not useful progress

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Checkpoint unchanged beyond hang threshold?
Default: 600 seconds

div.style: color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Controller checkpoint reports completed
Stop owned gameplay process
Supervisor records campaign completion

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p: Time remains and no stop request?

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Stop and reap owned gameplay process
Classify latest checkpoint and matching exit evidence

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Observe backend and enabled capabilities
Native entities, receipts, research,
owned routes, jobs and launch evidence

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Session, finite facts and monotonic tick valid?
Enabled capabilities match retained ownership?

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Running or uncertain controller
has an unresolved pending action?

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Maintenance and storage
admit new work?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Check prerequisite-ordered native predicates
Retain previously verified milestones
Defer goal changes during tracked background craft

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Persist completed checkpoint
Record verified completion and publish status

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Compile the effective capability-aware frontier
Bootstrap, serial or ready-work planner
Then apply committed-capital constraints

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Apply two-failure plan budget
Include connection failure attribution

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Mark blocked
Retain exact reason and failure history

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Ready-work: deduplicate and rank
Urgency, immediate need, estimated actor cost
Heuristics do not authorize execution

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Choose ready-work ranking first
Otherwise step count, then plan ID

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Commit selected plan and step index
Persist any capital or successor intent

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Observe again before dispatch
Recheck capability, maintenance and storage barriers

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Next step allowed by native state,
ownership, locks and capital budget?

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Required carried materials available
for reservation?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Persist pending = prepared BEFORE dispatch
Attempt identity, receipt, start tick and polls

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Execute one committed step
One dispatcher; no concurrent game mutations

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Proven local maintenance or storage rejection
Record rejected attempt; clear pending
Retain plan and reservations

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Persist ambiguous dispatch and error
Retain pending for reconciliation
Never blindly replay

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Observe after dispatch
Apply the composed execution barrier

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Background mode: accepted craft receipt
and paid-input evidence permit admission?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Persist job and original attempt
Lock future outputs; release paid-input reservation
Independent actions remain serial

div.style: color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Record verified attempt; release reservation
Clear pending, advance step
Reset stalled-decision count

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Clear completed plan
Refresh goal predicates when no background job

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Increment plan failure count
Release reservation and clear plan
Retain failures and paid construction

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Save checkpoint; append configured logs
Publish truthful status, decisions and evidence

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Wait configured interval within deadline
Ready-work acknowledged research waits may back off
No fixed deployed interval is assumed

div.style: color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Unhandled controller, persistence
or backend failure

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Fresh observation before new planning
Background extension also checks its retained job

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Select from current feasible plans
Ready-work: deduplicate and rank evidence
Rebuild selection state each decision

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Committed native action type?
One controller dispatch at a time

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Factory adapter raised an error
Controller distinguishes exact preflight rejection
from a potentially partial mutation

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Adapter returned; success is not yet verified
Legacy FLE act may return an error string
Controller observes the required postcondition

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Every later observation checks job identity,
monotonic progress, deadline and earned output
Persist before allowing independent work

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
stockpile_fuel prerequisite
At least 5 carried coal

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
bootstrap_mining target or prerequisite
Working burner drill, connected output
and at least 5 collected iron ore

div.style: color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
rocket_launch target
victory = true with exact source
native:base-game-rocket-launch

div.style: color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
iron_smelting target
At least 10 carried iron plates
and native produced counter at least 10

div.style: color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
steam_power target
Lab energy above zero; nonzero network ID
equal to the steam engine network ID

div.style: color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
automation_science target
At least 10 carried science packs
and native produced counter at least 10

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Dependencies are code, not a model plan
Record a milestone only after its prerequisites
Previously verified milestones stay completed

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;
color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Offer 5- or 10-coal inventory targets
Walk to observed coal when needed
Gather with five-unit backend macros

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Require 5 coal, one carried drill and chest
Walk to observed iron
Place drill with connected output chest

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Existing drill has no fuel
Gather coal if below 5 carried
Otherwise insert 5 coal

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Fueled connected drill: idle until measured ore grows
Factory-enabled path may first extract up to 50 ore
from a full connected output chest

div.style: color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Block on missing materials or observed resource,
unverified output connection, or no feasible step

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Skip satisfied steps and check next-step feasibility
No full-game compiler without native factory support

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Use the native recipe, technology
and machine catalog

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
serial: default
One bounded prerequisite plan

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
ready-work: opt-in
Compile once with the effective planner
Bound main lookahead to 32 items and 8 candidates by default

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Reuse supply and workload facts within this decision
Consider research resupply and paid recurring producers

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

Deterministic policy, or hybrid ready-work
with one distinct plan and healthy provider?

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

Facts, goal and last eight history events
Include scheduling evidence when available
Omit raw transfer receipts and connector lists

span.p:
Offer up to 16 plans plus observe
One choice and, for each plan:
benefit 0–2, disruption 0–2,
missing-start-evidence value 0–1

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Serialized state + questions fit budget?
Default: 32,000 UTF-8 bytes

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Drop final candidate and rebuild
Byte bound is not a token estimate

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
HTTP provider circuit admits a call?
Cooldown, exhaustion and interrupted requests
retain their durable incident budget

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Persist request reservation when configured
Call client once for the entire batch
HTTP clients use a 10-second timeout

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Record provider hold; keep observing
No hybrid fallback or stall-budget charge
No sleep inside provider evaluation

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
HTTP failure budgets: auth or quota: 3;
network or rate limit: 8; schema: 1
Interrupted healthy request exhausts at one
Backoff and bounded Retry-After; persist budget

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Exact question keys and answer types?
Finite values, complete distributions,
matching rubrics and consistent choice/scores?
Respect supported provider rounding

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Model chose observe
or choice confidence below floor?
Default floor: 0.45

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Exclude candidates needing evidence ≥ 0.5
or benefit/disruption confidence below floor

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Rank eligible offered plans:
choice probability + benefit / 4
− disruption / 8 − 0.02 per step
A heuristic, not success probability

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Select maximum-utility plan
It can differ from the choice label

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
No usable model decision
Retain reason and rejection diagnostics

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:

Otherwise: fewest steps, then plan ID
Uses feasible plans before model-byte pruning

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

Increment stalled-decision count

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Configured stall limit reached?
Default: four decisions

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Validate command and endpoint-specific invariants
Fair-action guard requires original connected actor,
normal speed and no cheats

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Request native path and use walking_state
Bounded safe detours; no obstacle destruction
Blocked routes cool down

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Retain observed target and entity token
Check cursor visibility and native reach
Walk to approach only when needed

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

Set native mining_state and count real gain
After depletion with progress, reacquire locally
Mine only the remaining committed quantity

span.p:

Walk only if outside native build reach
Build from carried cursor item; verify debit

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

Look up owned role; approach if needed
Check reach, source and destination capacity
Move paid items; write exact unit-bound receipt

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Discover compatible fluid ports or pole endpoints
Bound route search and reject impossible preflight
Place carried pipes or small electric poles

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Queue unlocked native handcraft
Require idle queue and directly supplied ingredients
Receipt adapter tracks supported craft jobs

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Approach machine; require unlocked recipe
Refuse reconfiguration with buffered ingredients

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Start available research without canceling another
Labs consume real science packs

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

Prepare paid landing pad, payload or fish
when requested by launch-readiness commands
Approach ready silo and request native launch

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

output chest/inserter; iron or copper outpost;
bounded ore belt route or production site
Receipt and native flow remain to be verified

div.style: color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Ore input routes are bounded iron/copper layouts
No general coal-belt or downstream
transport network is implemented here

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Wait / idle returns without advancing game time
Production and research continue in the engine

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Generate bounded normal map terrain
No synthetic resource grants

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Bind existing player and character
Adapter attachment stops old controls
Reject unreconciled legacy work

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Walking/mining polls fair.observe
Each successful poll renews a 180-tick lease
Sleep 0.1 seconds between RPCs
Default wall-clock wait limit: 180 seconds

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Finally stop walking/mining controls
Lease expiry, changed actor, stalled progress
or timeout can leave compound action ambiguous

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Execution barrier raised?
For example: failed background evidence

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Opt-in background work: unfinished single craft
returned with fully accepted paid native receipt?
Actor, queue, products and inventory match?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Persist job and original attempt in background
Release paid-input reservation; lock future outputs
Preserve native-start deadline; clear foreground plan

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Record verified completion; unlock outputs
Clear background job and attempt; persist

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Allow only independent gather, insert, extract
or wait without touching locked products
Use the same serial dispatcher

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Background extension: acknowledged craft-idle
or research wait with independent ready work?

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Expected effect now observed?
Use the action's exact postcondition

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Original ambiguous native transfer has exact
same-unit receipt for less than requested?
Zero quantity also requires retained source

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Prepared original transfer: approach started/returned,
transfer RPC never entered; no observation error,
no receipt; same unit, source and reservation?
Fresh preconditions and maintenance gate allow?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Persist recovery authorization and original phases
Dispatch identical transfer with original attempt
Persist returned state, then reobserve

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Retain original pending and attempt
Mark dispatch ambiguous after backend error
Do not replay an unproved transfer

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;
color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Ambiguous place: absent role and zero global count
Ambiguous connection: zero connector count
Both require retained reserved materials
Prepared/ambiguous gather: after a prior poll,
gain above baseline but below target

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: factory_wait with boiler coal below five?

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Ready-work: acknowledged machine-output wait
has an allowed, unsatisfied non-wait candidate?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Finish nonmutating wait; clear plan
Replan maintenance or available useful work

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Step tick timeout or poll limit reached?
Factory-enabled controllers use at least 1,800 polls

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Mark uncertain; retain unresolved evidence
Preserve pending, attempt and reservations
Require valid reconciliation before mutation

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Keep observing without redispatch
Real game time advances naturally
Only explicit mock mode dispatches idle for time

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;
color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Block for operator reconciliation; exit 2
Provider, quota, storage, native failure,
uncertain outcome or unclassified exit
Preserve pending actions and original cutoff

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Capture immutable incident checkpoint and source
Reuse this baseline after rejection or restart

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Time remains before original cutoff
and no stop request?

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Incident repair budget available
and repair account unblocked?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Persist attempt and audit identity
Launch configured repair command with prompt
Default attempt limit: 30 minutes, capped by cutoff

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Diagnose source, logs and available native evidence
Preserve session, pending and fairness
Repair agent must not launch gameplay

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Evidence-backed operational reconciliation
Source identity and HEAD unchanged
Pending and reservations remain for controller verification

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Implement focused fix and regression tests
Run focused and full tests
Keep normal walking, mining, reach and 1x speed

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Commit and push focused repair branch
Open or update pull request

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Independent review of exact PR head
GitHub approval or separate-agent source artifact

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Checks pass and exact-head review approves
with no outstanding changes requested?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Merge without bypassing branch rules
Synchronize clean local HEAD and origin/main
Also synchronize fork/main if configured

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Write structured result with concrete evidence
Code and operational claims have distinct requirements

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Supervisor validates checkpoint and report
Preserve pending, attempt, plans, reservations,
background commitments, outcomes and failure budgets

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
For code: independently verify merged PR, review,
checks, exact commit, clean tree and remote main tips
Run full pytest or validate exact prevalidation artifact

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Recheck unchanged result bytes and source revision
Record source segment and durable acceptance event

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Keep gameplay stopped; record rejected attempt
Exponential backoff capped at 15 minutes
Default budget: 3 attempts per incident

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Repair account quota exhausted
or incident attempt budget spent?

div.style: color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Clear accepted repair-required gate
Keep original world, checkpoint and cutoff
Only supervisor may resume gameplay
